snippet.title: BRASIER
snippet.description:
BRASIER is a short horror game inspired by classic survival horrors with light combat elements and focus on symbolism. Made for the @HauntedPS1 halloween game jam !

Grab it for free here : https://xena-spectrale.itch.io/brasier

Follow - Support:
 ▶▶▶▶ https://xena-spectrale.net/land

See you around !
